name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-v12-dev
description: Dev package for @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext. Never published. The published package is ./pkg.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:foundry && npm run check:forge-fmt-config && npm run build:forge && npm run test:vendored && npm run prettier:check && npm run forge:fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run check:zama-config && npm run check:cleartext-config && npm run check:exports && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types && npm run test:publint
scripts.build:forge: forge clean && forge build --skip test && npm run check:contract-sizes
scripts.build:tarball: npm run build:templates && npm run build && npm run pack:tarball
scripts.build:templates: npm run generate:cleartext-config && npm run generate:contract-versions && npm run generate:exports && npm run generate:compute-addresses && npm run generate:placeholders && npm run build:forge && node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.clean: rm -rf cache out broadcast internal/.deploy-config internal/.tmp-localhost *.tsbuildinfo internal/*.tsbuildinfo test/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/_esm pkg/ts/_cjs pkg/ts/_types
scripts.generate:templates: node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.lint: npm run check:lint-policy && npm run forge:lint && eslint && tsc -b ./tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./create2-deploy/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project test/ts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run && npm run test:forge && npm run test:harness:run
scripts.test:templates: npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run
